what: The bases fd17f32's proforma.reference_inputs and proforma.benchmark_inputs wrote on a host with no Graphviz, before the shelf's hand-written reference entries retired (alpha 2.2 D8, C.6): a run a person kept from either entry rests on one of these, and test_proforma's sim tests keep and replay a run on each in the real worker. Captured by importing that commit's core and dumping each list; versions and words alone, no value of any plant.

biorefineries.corn's SimultaneousSaccharificationFermentation passes its two inlets (the mash and the yeast) to bst.BatchBioreactor, which declares one fixed inlet in biosteam 2.54.0, so corn.load() stops with 'at most 1 streams expected; 2 given'. The flowsheet lets the unit take them, as biosteam's own NRELEthanolFermentation declares; the unit's _run already mixes every inlet. No number of the package's is changed, and the package's own test values hold within its tolerance.
every number the run keeps is rounded so: BioSTEAM sums a set of units in an order that moves the last digits from one build to the next, and a replay compares the plant
